title: GetProductContentScore
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: get product content score
html:
Request Address

GET/POST/product/content/score/get
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringYesAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
item_idNumberYesCall this API; "Item Id" must be selected as the request parameter.

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
resultObjectYesResult
  dataObjectYesResponse body
    productTitleStringNoProduct title
    scoreNumberNoProduct's latest content score
    imageStringNoThe main image of the selected product for a quick product information summary
    totalNumberNoThe total full content score
    productIdNumberNoProduct ID
    itemsObject[]NoIssue list that need to be optimized of the selected product
      keyStringNoUnique key to identify each issue
      scoreNumberNoThe current score got in this issue
      totalNumberNoThe total score of this issue
      groupStringNoIndicates the group of the issue, such as Content Completeness and Content Quality name The name of each issue to be displayed to sellers.
      labelStringNoThe extra high-level guidance and suggestion for this issue.
      latestBooleanNoOptional field. Will only return for certain issues which need offline calculation. Value "false" means this issue has been optimized but still under system calculation and may update in 2 days.
      indicatorsObject[]NoOptional field. Some extra details (usually for sub issues) and will only return for certain issues. Please check API response examples for more information.
        criticalBooleanNoTo mark the critical issues which leads to 0 product score and represents potential content policy violations
        textStringNoDetailed name and description of the sub issue.
        keyStringNoUnique key of the sub issue.
      imageListObject[]NoOptional field. Only available for product with Image Quality issue. List the issue and image breakdown.
        scoreNumberNoThe score of each image.
        imageUrlStringNoThe url of the image with image quality issue
        textStringNoThe image name, e.g product image/SKU image/long image/square image.
        typeStringNoThe score level of each image, e.g. low/moderate. This level is mapped to score.
        imageTypeNumberNoThe enum of image type, e.g product image/SKU image/long image/square image.
        indicatorsObject[]NoOptional field. Some extra details (usually for sub issues) and will only return for certain issues. Please check API response examples for more information.
          textStringNoDetailed name and description of the sub issue.
          keyStringNoUnique key of the sub issue.
      itemTitleStringNoThe name of each issue to be displayed to sellers.
